event.text: I recommend you be seen in person today for this foot wound — same-day clinic, urgent care or podiatry — rather than handled by message alone. In diabetes, a cut on the sole with surrounding redness, swelling and tenderness needs direct inspection to judge depth and infection. If no capable service can assess it today, go to an emergency department today instead of waiting for a reply. A Counsel clinician can stay involved in this thread. If you develop fever, chills, red streaks up the leg, rapidly increasing pain, or the skin turns dusky or purple, go to an emergency department now.
